items.title_en: Truth behind horrifying tentacled object that was growing on ISS
items.title_zh: 国际空间站上生长的可怕触手物体背后的真相
items.summary_en: An image of a strange, tentacled object has been circulating online, with some comparing it to something out of a sci-fi movie. But what is it really? The viral post, shared on X by NASA astronaut Don Pettit, might leave you feeling uneasy at first glance. However, the object is far less sinister than it appears, a reminder that looks can be deceiving.
items.summary_zh: 一张带有触手的奇怪物体的图片在网上流传，一些人将其与科幻电影中的物体进行比较。但它到底是什么？这篇由 NASA 宇航员唐·佩蒂特 (Don Pettit) 在 X 上疯传的帖子可能会让你乍一看感到不安。然而，这个物体远没有看上去那么险恶，这提醒人们，外表可能具有欺骗性。
